resources.string: On the camera choose Send to Computer. The phone and camera must be on the same Wi-Fi, or the camera on this phone\'s hotspot.
Camera not found. Is Send to Computer on, and is the camera on this Wi-Fi or hotspot? If it was used a moment ago, press Cancel on the camera and choose Send to Computer again.
Disconnected. The camera was sent to sleep.
Connection to the camera was lost. Press Cancel on the camera, choose Send to Computer again and connect.
Could not join the camera\'s Wi-Fi. On the camera open a photo in playback (or choose Send to Smartphone), touch the phone to the N mark again, or press the button.
This NFC tag is not a Sony camera.
Allow access to nearby Wi-Fi devices so the app can join the camera\'s network.
Or: open a photo on the camera, then touch the phone to the N mark.
